name: Circle of the Stars (Druid Subclass - 2024)
description: Druids of the Circle of the Stars draw power from the constellations, using starlight to heal, harm, and gain cosmic insights.

3.name: Star Map
3.description: You create/receive a star map focus. You learn the Guidance cantrip and Guiding Bolt spell. You can cast Guiding Bolt without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (min 1) per long rest.

3.name: Starry Form
3.description: As a bonus action, expend a use of Wild Shape to take on a starry form for 10 minutes. Choose one constellation: Archer (Bonus action ranged spell attack for 1d8+Wis radiant damage; 2d8 at L10), Chalice (When casting a spell restoring HP, you or another creature within 30ft regains 1d8+Wis HP; 2d8 at L10), Dragon (When making Int/Wis check or Con save for concentration, treat d20 roll of 9 or lower as 10; gains 20ft fly speed at L10).

6.name: Cosmic Omen
6.description: When you finish a long rest, roll a d6. On an even roll, you are Weal; on an odd roll, you are Woe. When a creature you can see within 30 feet is about to make an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, you can use your reaction to expend a spell slot to add (Weal) or subtract (Woe) 1d6 from the roll.

10.name: Twinkling Constellations
10.description: The Archer form_s damage and Chalice form_s healing increase to 2d8. The Dragon form grants a 20-foot flying speed. You can change your active Starry Form constellation as a bonus action.

14.name: Full of Stars
14.description: While your Starry Form is active, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
